issue_context.title: Cancelled context is not converted properly to an ErrCancelled
issue_context.body:
**Steps to reproduce the issue:**

1. any program that uses the standard `logrus` logger, set to debug
2. every time when the context is canceled

**Describe the results you received:**

docker client:
```
...
DEBU[2020-11-22T20:48:52+01:00] FIXME: Got an status-code for which error does not match any expected type!!!: -1  module=api status_c
ode=-1
...
```

**Describe the results you expected:**  

The result should not be `errUnknown`

_Originally posted by @kplachkov in https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/41667#issuecomment-731845505_

review_comments: Just a nit, I'd wait for `<-ctx.Done()`
